explanation: OEIS A052709 (g.f. (1 − √(1 − 4x − 4x²))/(2(1+x))), G. Wiseman: for n > 0, a(n) is the number of sequences of length n − 1 covering an initial interval of positive integers and avoiding x ≤ y ≤ z at positions i < j < k. The formal a(n) = Σ_k Catalan(k)·C(k, n−1−k) reproduces the DATA 0, 1, 1, 3, …. coversInitialInterval (positive entries whose value set is {1..max}; the empty list for n = 1) and avoidsPatternXYZ (no weakly increasing length-3 subsequence) match the description. The count is taken as the cardinality of the (finite) set, with any Fintype instance. Faithful.
